findings.title: get_state_data KeyErrors when counter_names is empty
findings.body: get_state_data initializes counter_updates as {} and only populates it inside `if self.counter_names:`. The result-building loop then unconditionally does `counter_updates[gk]`. A detector with `counter_names == []` and any group keys therefore raises KeyError, making stateless-counter detectors unusable. Fix by defaulting to empty dict per group key, e.g. `counter_updates.get(gk, {})`.

findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler was changed to subclass StatefulDetectorHandler but remains `pass`. StatefulDetectorHandler has abstract members `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and new `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. Instantiating the handler via `Detector.detector_handler` will raise TypeError for an abstract class, turning every metric-alert detector evaluation into an exception instead of the previous no-op returning []. Implement the methods or keep it as a plain DetectorHandler until ready.
